description: This file contains the implementation of the RequestFactory class within the Slim Framework's PSR-7 integration, used to create HTTP request objects.

classes.name: RequestFactory
classes.description: Implements the RequestFactoryInterface to create PSR-7 Request objects with optional custom stream and URI factories.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that accepts optional stream and URI factories, defaulting to StreamFactory and UriFactory if not provided.

methods.name: createRequest
methods.description: Creates and returns a new Request object with the specified HTTP method and URI, utilizing the internal factories.
